text: The cart service is experiencing issues due to a missing CART_ADDR environment variable in its deployment configuration [S1]. This is preventing the service from connecting to Redis [S1]. The fault lies within the cart deployment's pod specification [E1]. M2 proposes to patch the cart deployment by adding the CART_ADDR environment variable with the value 'redis-cart:6379' [E1]. This proposed fix will be checked by the safety gate (M3) before it runs. The reads confirmed this diagnosis.
